about.intro: I'm a *Full Stack Developer* building **responsive, user-centric web applications**.
about.description: I work across React.js, JavaScript, Python, Django, Flask, REST APIs, and database-driven systems, with a focus on clear architecture and reliable interfaces.
about.full:
Hi, I'm **Muhammad Sahal**, a Full Stack Developer based in Bangalore, India. I build responsive web applications with *React.js*, *JavaScript*, *Python*, *Django*, and *Flask*, connecting thoughtful interfaces to REST APIs and relational or document databases.

My experience includes building authentication systems, CRUD workflows, role-based applications, database-backed features, and a Smart Document Analyzer using *Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)* and semantic search. I care about maintainable code, responsive design, and understanding the problem behind the product.

I'm pursuing a B.E. in Information Science and Engineering at Yenepoya Institute of Technology, affiliated to VTU.

projects.title: Admission CRM & Lead Management Platform-Edu_Lead
projects.description: Rol tabanlı operasyonlar, adil nöbetçi danışman dağıtımı, dinamik yaşlanma takibi ve SLA izleme özelliklerine sahip kurumsal kabul CRM ve potansiyel müşteri yönetim platformu.

Aşama atlamayı önleyen katı yaşam döngüsü durum makinesi (Yeni → İletişime Geçildi → İlgilendi → Planlandı → Dönüştürüldü).
Dinamik müşteri yaşlanma sınıflandırması ve otomatik gecikmiş SLA tespiti.

projects.title: Online Grocery E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: A full-stack e-commerce application with a Django backend, MySQL database, and JavaScript-driven frontend. The platform covers authentication, product management, cart, wishlist, checkout, and an admin dashboard.
highlights: Designed relational database models and implemented CRUD operations with session-based authentication.
Built product management, order tracking, analytics, and report-generation workflows for the admin dashboard.
Connected responsive frontend interfaces with Django backend services.

projects.title: AI-Powered Career Companion
projects.description: A career guidance application with responsive interfaces for resume analysis, job matching, and career recommendation workflows using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Flask integration.
highlights: Developed responsive frontend interfaces for career workflows.
Integrated Flask services for resume analysis, job matching, and career recommendations.

projects.title: Salon Appointment Booking Platform
projects.description: A responsive appointment booking platform with scheduling, booking, and admin management features, integrating frontend components with backend services and MongoDB for data persistence.
highlights: Developed responsive booking and scheduling interfaces.
Integrated frontend components with backend services.
Used MongoDB for application data persistence.

projects.title: Food Waste Management E-Commerce Platform
projects.description: An e-commerce platform enabling restaurants to sell surplus food online through responsive interfaces and database-driven functionality.
highlights: Developed responsive interfaces for surplus-food listings and online purchases.
